summary: Data-backed critique of India's tax system: income tax collection doubled to ~Rs 23.4 lakh cr in 5-6 years and now exceeds corporate tax (~Rs 12.41L cr vs ~Rs 11L cr), while citizens pay 20+ types of taxes across centre, state and local bodies (a Rs 15L Delhi earner pays ~15% of salary in taxes). Of every Rs 100 the government gets, ~Rs 24 is borrowed and ~Rs 26 goes to interest payments, while education (~Rs 2.60) and health (~Rs 2) get little. India ranks worst among top-10 GDP nations on HDI, life expectancy (72), schooling (6.9 yrs), air pollution, safe water and per-capita health spend ($346). Root causes: a narrow tax net (only 5-6% file, ~63% declare zero liability) and inefficient spending. Calls: none.
title: Why Honest Tax Payers get punished - our tax system is BROKEN! | Rahul Jain
